title: The Petals Monarch Problem
text:
The title spread.

Petals Monarch.

First among children.

Then soldiers.

Then martial newspapers.

Then official reports.

Rhen hated all of them.

Sera loved this.

[[speaker:sera]]“Your Majesty.”

Rhen stared.

[[speaker:sera]]“Tea?”

Silence.

[[speaker:sera]]“Petals Monarch?”

Rhen walked away.

Sera laughed until customers looked concerned.

The man who had defeated the Ancient Overlord had finally found an enemy he could not kill.

A nickname.

title: Pilgrims
text:
People began visiting the tea shop.

Not customers.

Pilgrims.

Cultivators hoping to see Rhen.

Parents carrying children.

Old soldiers.

Young fighters.

People leaving frozen-petal charms outside the door.

Rhen endured it for three days.

On day four, someone bowed while he was carrying rubbish outside.

He walked back in.

[[speaker:rhen]]“We should move.”

Sera looked up from the register.

[[speaker:sera]]“Already packed.”

Rhen stared.

She smiled.

Marriage remained unfair.

title: Sera's Fame Is Worse
text:
Moving was complicated because Sera had become famous too.

Former World #6.

Duke-level after retirement.

Strategist of the King War.

Wife of the Petals Monarch.

Sera hated the last description most.

[[speaker:sera]]“I have a name.”

Rhen nodded.

[[speaker:rhen]]“You do.”

[[speaker:sera]]“That was not permission to be smug.”

They considered three towns.

One recognized Sera.

One recognized Rhen.

The third recognized neither but had terrible tea water.

Sera rejected it immediately.

title: Ilyra Visits the Quiet Cup
text:
Ilyra visited before they left.

World #6 placed Sera's old ranking tablet on the table.

Not returning it.

Showing it.

[[speaker:ilyra]]“You were correct.”

Sera looked at the number.

[[speaker:sera]]“About?”

[[speaker:ilyra]]“It is only a number.”

Sera smiled.

Ilyra had entered the East as former Crown II.

Survived the assassination because she abandoned that identity.

Protected Marquises.

Protected Dukes.

Helped defeat Kings.

Now #6 belonged to her completely.

Sera pushed the tablet back.

[[speaker:sera]]“Take care of them.”

Ilyra looked toward Mo arguing outside.

[[speaker:ilyra]]“Unfortunately.”

title: The One-Mile Gift
text:
Before leaving, Rhen extended A Thousand Petals Without Falling to Ilyra for one hour.

She noticed immediately.

Every circulation inefficiency corrected itself.

Old scars softened.

Twin Meridian Scripture synchronized more cleanly without becoming symmetrical.

Ilyra looked at him.

[[speaker:ilyra]]“Sera lived inside this for a year?”

[[speaker:rhen]]“Yes.”

Ilyra looked at Sera.

[[speaker:ilyra]]“Marriage, apparently.”

Sera covered her face.

The joke had escaped containment.

title: A New Tea Route
text:
Rhen and Sera travelled without escorts.

No ranking insignia.

No official carriage.

One cart.

Tea leaves.

Clothes.

Two boxes of books.

Far too many cups.

They argued over routes.

Sera wanted the coast.

Rhen wanted mountains.

They compromised on a quiet valley near a trade road.

[[speaker:sera]]“This is closer to mountains.”

[[speaker:rhen]]“There is a river.”

[[speaker:sera]]“Tiny.”

[[speaker:rhen]]“Still water.”

She narrowed her eyes.

He smiled.

They bought the building anyway.

title: The Sign
text:
The new shop needed a name.

Sera suggested something ordinary.

Rhen suggested nothing.

Mo had secretly mailed a sign ahead.

THE PETALS MONARCH TEA HOUSE.

Sera laughed so hard she nearly dropped it.

Rhen stared at the sign for a full minute.

Then burned it with the smallest possible pulse of qi.

Sera wiped tears from her eyes.

[[speaker:sera]]“Worth it.”

They eventually chose:

**THE QUIET CUP.**

Rhen approved.

Sera approved more.

title: Nobody Knows Them
text:
The first customer was a farmer.

He did not recognize either of them.

Ordered tea.

Complained it was slightly expensive.

Sera almost hugged him.

The second customer argued about sugar.

The third fell asleep at a table.

No one bowed.

No one asked about Kings.

No one said Petals Monarch.

Rhen cleaned cups.

Sera worked the counter.

Not since the final battle had the situation shifted this sharply; retirement felt real again.

title: One Frozen Charm
text:
A week later, Sera found a frozen-petal charm outside the door.

She stared.

Rhen looked over her shoulder.

Both froze.

Had they been found?

Sera picked it up.

A note was attached.

THANK YOU FOR THE TEA. IT WAS NICE.

Nothing else.

No title.

No martial reference.

A child had simply liked the petal decorations painted on the cups.

Sera laughed.

Rhen smiled.

False alarm.

title: Quiet Again
text:
The world continued without them.

Ilyra held #6.

The Dukes rebuilt.

Tae remained annoying.

Jin found more maps.

The western territories learned to govern themselves.

Rhen and Sera sold tea.

At night, Sera sometimes trained.

Not for rank.

Because she enjoyed being strong now that strength belonged entirely to her.

Rhen sometimes joined.

Usually he cheated by being Rhen.

Then they went back inside.

Quiet again.
